keyword: how many majors has scottie scheffler won
claims: As of April 2026, Scottie Scheffler has won four major championships.
Scottie Scheffler won the Masters Tournament in 2022.
Scottie Scheffler won the Masters Tournament in 2024.
Scottie Scheffler won the PGA Championship in 2025.
Scottie Scheffler won The Open Championship in 2025.
Scottie Scheffler secured these four titles within a five-year span.
Scottie Scheffler's best U.S. Open finish is a tie for second in 2022.
